_doc: Physical layout of the ST185-harness drawing set (every harness of the master in one drawing set) for build_drawings.py: the trunk and branches as a tree, top view (front of the car to the RIGHT, driver side UP; DECISIONS R140 / R153), with segment lengths in mm. Whole-car frame: x -20 (rear bumper) .. 90 (firewall) .. 140 (front bumper), y 0 passenger edge .. 100 driver edge. Lengths come from the approved routes (AB-cabin: these segments are its placement-editor layout, approved as is by Dan 2026-11-03, plus the 6 in (152 mm) glove-box breakout GB_T-GB the editor does not draw (Dan T2 a; editor db `layouts/ABcabin` v4, every line length equal to its segment here; OPEN-ITEMS row 180; Routes 5 / 6 were deleted 2026-10-26); AB-engine: built at run time from Route 16 by `route_trees`, DECISIONS B8: map length x 5.3 mm per EWD point + 300 mm drop for a low part; each bulkhead-to-device path = the master est_length_mm; EngineRoom-C (harness C): built the same way from Route 17, rooted at RFG (run 10, RH fender exit) and LFP (run 11, driver kick), riding Route 16 lines 9 / 6 / 4 / 2 to the A/C, alternator plug, MR-S pump plug A and block stud, its own copies of those nodes (prefix C_), and ground studs EA / EB on their factory bolts (Dan 2026-11-01; the EB strap lug GND-EB-2 is the same bolt drawn twice)) and the old A-cabin / B-cabin bundle lengths (2026-10-19); the other harnesses from the old Routes 1, 2 and 7-15 (2026-10-20; Routes 2-7 and 15 since deleted, each harness gets a placement pass, DECISIONS B8). HeavyDC (Dan B6 b, 2026-11-02): its own Route 1 tree, the segments from the old Route 1 page (trunk battery up the RH sill to the glove box, the RADLOK pair through the RH firewall (FW_STR-RL_ENG, 0 mm), then the starter, alternator, block stud and jump post); its Route 16 ends are marked moved_to in Route 16, so no HeavyDC segment reaches the Route 16 tree (OPEN-ITEMS row 179 loops gone); these segments are its placement-editor layout, approved as is by Dan 2026-11-04 22:32 (editor db `layouts/HeavyDC` v1, `unchangedSeed`: every editor line length equal to its segment here, the glove-box run to ground ID riding the AB-cabin dash segments from GB_T; OPEN-ITEMS row 180). Each harness is its own bundle and the layout must stay a tree, so a place reached two ways is drawn twice (the starter: S post on the engine tree, through bulkhead cavity 3, B+ stud on the heavy-cable tree); they are estimates until measured at the car (OPEN-ITEMS row 143). Positions (`xy`, a 0-100 frame: x toward the front, y toward the driver side) are drawing positions only, not to scale; `short` is the name drawn on the sheet. The AB-engine bulkhead splices SP-GNDOUT-ENG / SP-SW12-ENG are placed at J_BH_ENG_drop (the trunk junction 16 in below the bulkhead), where Dan approved them (N2 a / N4 a, #499; README engine harness rule: splices near the bulkhead, never mid-run). Every wire end of the wire list is placed on a node by `place` (the master end ID) or `place_oem` (text in the factory end's name); build_drawings.py --check fails on an end it cannot place. `lab` (left / below / above) moves a node name off its segments.

ECU.label: ECU plugs A / B (centre dash, factory ECM spot)

SP.label: ECU splice point (bussed DT plugs + soldered splices)

GB.label: Glove box: POWER + LOGIC boxes (every cabin fuse and relay), NEG bar, SW12 bus, blower lead
GB.short: Glove box: POWER + LOGIC boxes, NEG bar

RHKICK.label: RH kick panel (old R/B No.4 spot): ST1 / heater taps, ground IG
RHKICK.short: RH kick panel (old R/B4, ground IG)

RHSILL.label: RH sill, rear end (the run turns across the trunk)

DASH.label: Mid-dash above the ECU: front + rear WS inlines, A/C switch lead

JB1.label: J/B No.1 + cowl plug IE1, LH kick panel: IG2 / tail / turn taps, door switch lead, ground ID (Routes 2, 7, 15)

ALARM.label: Alarm spot (centre dash, left of the ECU): the alarm-ready tap points AL-*, no alarm fitted yet (Dan 2026-11-06)

CSB3.label: Centre console: CSB3 under the centre cluster, its switch inputs and opto board (Route 12)

CANJ.label: By ECU plug C: the CAN trunk leaves ECU plug C here and runs out past the switch board, cluster and Pi taps, then on to the bulkhead (Dan P1 / T1 a, 2026-11-09)

BH_ENG.label: DRB102 bulkhead, engine half (RH firewall); the engine tree is built from Route 16 (route_trees)

FW_STR.label: RH firewall: RADLOK pair, cabin side - spot TBD (Route 1 point 1)

CLUSTER.label: Centre cluster (old meter spot): LED board on the meter plugs C13 (B) / C14 (C), cluster CAN board + buck, J/B No.3 behind it (Routes 8, 13)

PI.label: RealDash Pi + USB-CAN adapter, centre dash, and the dash 12 V split (Route 8)

COLUMN.label: Steering column: combination switch plug C16 (B), cruise control switch pins 5 / 15 / 17 (1993 EWD grid 59; Route 12, spot approximate)

DRL_SW.label: DRL switch, lower dash left of the steering wheel (Dan 2026-11-08; spot rough, Dan refines it in the CabinPower editor; branch length from his 2026-11-08 save)

RFG.label: Harness C out of the cabin into the RH fender by the hood hinge (Route 17 run 10 start; the harness C tree is built from Route 17 by route_trees)

RFP.label: RH fender pass-through by the strut tower: FR wheel-speed plug (Route 9 rev 2)

LFP.label: LH fender pass-through by the strut tower, driver kick: FL wheel-speed plug; wiper feed out to the cowl (Routes 2, 9)

RPANEL.label: Rear panel centre: factory ground point BL (fuel pump ground ring, Dan N97 a); leg length from the tank is an estimate until Dan refines it

WSRL.label: RL ABS sensor plug (rear left): its cable crosses under the rear seat to the RH sill run (shared trunk with the fuel / battery wires, N120 2026-11-08)

WSRR.label: RR ABS sensor plug (rear right), off the RH sill run (shared trunk with the fuel / battery wires, N120 2026-11-08)

TANK.label: Fuel level sender at the tank top (DT 2-way); the AB-cabin sill run lands straight on its plug, no inline pair (Dan N1 a, 2026-11-08); the pump has its own node PUMP

PUMP.label: Fuel pump at the tank top; its +12 V feed runs straight from the fuel pump relay in the trunk RH relay block (Dan 2026-11-08: relay wires go directly to the pump), its ground on to BL

BATT.label: Trunk RH rear corner: battery, kill switch, battery relay block (FP 40 A fuse + fuel pump relay K-FP) (Route 1 points 1, 4)
BATT.short: Trunk RH: battery, kill sw, relay block

C_FEND.label: Old Route 2 RH inner fender point: kept only for the hood pin pull-wire and the heavy-cable path to the engine tree (ground studs EA / EB sit on Route 17 devices 24 / 25)

C_RHC.label: Old Route 2 RH front corner: the hood pin pull-wire end AL-HOOD-BAY (ground stud EA sits on Route 17 device 24)
C_RHC.short: old RH front corner: hood pin pull-wire

C_FRONT.label: Old Route 2 front centre: no wire uses it now (ground stud EB sits on Route 17 device 25)

C_LHC.label: Old Route 2 LH front corner: no wire uses it now (ground stud EB sits on Route 17 device 25)

SIREN.label: Siren pull-wire ends (AL-SIREN-BAY, AL-SIREN-GND-BAY): centre of the firewall behind the engine, reached through the LH kick / fender pass-through (Dan B19, N101 b 2026-11-08; LFP-SIREN 964 mm from Dan's AntiTheft save)

RL_ENG.label: RADLOK + / - pair, engine side (RH firewall) (Route 1 point 1); the RADLOK pair is one firewall pass-through, so FW_STR-RL_ENG is 0 mm

ALT_B.label: Alternator B+ stud, rear RH of the engine (Route 1 point 3)

STARTER_B.label: Starter B+ stud, one lug (Route 1 point 2)

JUMP.label: OEM battery spot: jump bus bar and jump post side by side (Route 1 point 6, proposed spot)

GB_T.label: glove-box breakout: POWER / LOGIC boxes leave the glove-box run 6 in (152 mm) off it (DECISIONS 6 in breakout rule; Dan T2 a 2026-11-03)

ENG_BLOCK.label: Engine block ground stud, lug 1 (Route 1 point 5)

TAP_CSB.label: CAN trunk switch board tap: CAN H / L and shield splices; the switch board drop cable leaves here (80 mm to the switch board) (Dan P1, 2026-11-09, DECISIONS "CAN wiring (B17)")

TAP_CLU.label: CAN trunk cluster tap: CAN H / L and shield splices; the cluster drop cable leaves here (80 mm to the cluster) (Dan P1, 2026-11-09, DECISIONS "CAN wiring (B17)")

TAP_RD.label: CAN trunk RealDash Pi tap: CAN H / L and shield splices; the RealDash Pi drop cable leaves here (80 mm to the RealDash Pi) (Dan P1, 2026-11-09, DECISIONS "CAN wiring (B17)")
